target.name: Apollo Senior Floating Rate Fund Inc.

announcement.quote: You are cordially invited to attend a joint special stockholder meeting (the “Special Meeting”) of Apollo Senior

outcome_evidence.quote: shareholders did not approve the proposals applicable to AFT described in the Joint Proxy Statement/Prospectus of Apollo Tactical Income Fund, Inc. dated May 18, 2021 (the “Proxy Statement”). As a result, the Special Meeting of shareholders of AFT has been concluded.

deals.notes: AFT is shown as NYSE: AFT (0001193125-21-240466) and is described as a closed-end fund; AIF is called an Apollo-advised closed-end fund (0001193125-21-221831) but no excerpt states an exchange for AIF, so both_listed is null. The first filing's excerpt only fragmentarily names the joint special meeting; 0001193125-21-221831 (2021-07-22) states the proposal: the reorganization of AFT into AIF. The AIF-side special meeting result is previewed in 0001193125-21-203289 (2021-06-29, AFT meeting adjourned) but its outcome text is not shown. Failure rests on the AFT stockholder vote, with the AFT special meeting concluded on 2021-08-09.

problems: The 2021 DEF 14A and DEFA14A (0001193125-21-111630, -111636, -167528) concern annual meetings (director election, adjournment); the 2022 PRE 14A, DEF 14A and DEFA14A (0001133228-22-001727, -002212, -002216) show only cover pages, so nothing about a merger in them.
